catalogue.detailAccess: All entries belong to this experiment. Use consult ability with its ID to retain its full executable schema for subsequent decisions. Public implementation does not grant personal mastery.

request.name: Preserve gathered roots
request.function: Provide a practical way to slow spoilage of gathered edible roots while retaining their food safety and useful nutrition.
request.conditions: I am outdoors on ordinary forest soil, holding three roots gathered at tick 7. At tick 11 their displayed decay is 4.89430482. Roots are known to provide 14 nutrition and zero toxicity. I have no observed storage equipment or processing tools.
request.inputs: Owned roots; any additional materials or equipment must be identified and actually acquired. Feasible method unknown.
request.costs: Unknown; specify actual material, energy and time requirements.
request.effects: A physically grounded, testable reduction in spoilage if feasible, with explicit storage conditions and limitations; no assumed healing or satisfaction.

shown.question: Can I safely extend the useful storage life of gathered roots?
evidence: Eating one root at tick 8 provided 14 nutrition.
Three roots remain in inventory with displayed decay 4.89430482.
The observed public capability register contains 16 baseline interfaces.
shown.uncertainty: A feasible preservation method, its materials, costs and actual effect are unknown.
shown.goal: Maintain safe food reserves with less spoilage.
shown.missing: An implemented preservation method and a measured storage result.
shown.next: Request review of a practical root-preservation capability.
shown.benefit: The eaten root restored satiety; no preservation benefit has been demonstrated.

request.name: Preserve gathered food
request.function: Provide a feasible way to slow spoilage of personally owned gathered food while retaining safe usable nutrition.
request.conditions: At tick 9 I am at the Cedar meeting location outdoors, with three gathered roots whose stack shows decay 7.49483895. Roots have known nutrition 14 and toxicity 0. No preservation method or equipment is known.
request.inputs: Owned roots; other necessary materials and equipment are unknown.
request.costs: Unknown; identify feasible material, energy, and time costs.
request.effects: An implemented preservation process with explicit requirements and measurable spoilage and nutrition effects; no assumed supplies or mastery.

input.contextPolicy: Object IDs refer to deduplicated actual applicant observations. Whole records are selected with omission counts. Missing detail is unknown, not proof of absence. Full retained state is available during the development handoff; implementation must validate actual prerequisites and ownership.
input.implementation: New interfaces, state, geometry, persistent processes, rendering components and personal memory/task adapters can be delivered through a versioned current-conversation handoff. Source validation and history must remain intact. Declared implementation does not supply stock, objects or mastery.
